description: This file defines a custom RecyclerView ItemDecoration used to control spacing between items in a grid layout, with configurable parameters for number of columns, spacing amount, and whether edges are included.

classes.name: GridSpacingItemDecoration
classes.description: A class for customizing spacing between grid items in a RecyclerView, supporting edge inclusion and configurable spacing.

methods.name: getItemOffsets
methods.description: Overrides RecyclerView.ItemDecoration method to specify spacing offsets for each item based on position and grid parameters.
